lines.text: [Verse 1]
He ain’t counting miles no more
Ain’t chasing ghosts or settling scores
Got a tank half full and a sky that’s wide
And a machine that knows him better than pride
[Verse 2]
There’s lines on his hands and a few on his face
Some he earned, some he can’t replace
Left a trail of smoke and a couple regrets
But he don’t waste time on what ain’t paid yet
[Pre-Chorus]
He ain’t looking back this time
No rearview ghosts, no borrowed lines
[Chorus]
This is my last ride, don’t wait up for me
No map, no mercy, just the road and me
Let the sun go down in a fire I made
I ain’t asking forgiveness for the life I gave
If there’s something out there, it can take its time
I’ve been living fast on a borrowed line
This is my last ride...
And it’s mine
[Harmonica Turnaround]
[Verse 3]
They said slow down, said play it safe
But I never learned how to live that way
If the wheels fall off before I’m done
At least I’ll know I burned like the setting sun
[Instrumental Break — Acoustic Guitar and Blues Harmonica]
[Bridge — Pull Back]
All the miles ain’t what makes a man
It’s the roads he chose, not the ones he ran
And I’d do it again if I had the chance
Every wrong turn, every reckless dance
[Harmonica Answer]
[Final Chorus — Quiet Build]
This is my last ride, don’t wait up for me
No map, no mercy, just the road and me
Let the sun go down in a fire I made
I ain’t asking forgiveness for the life I gave
If there’s something out there, it can take its time
I’ve been living fast on a borrowed line
This is my last ride...
And it’s mine
[Outro — Sparse]
This is my last ride...
[Long Blues Harmonica Solo]
And it’s mine
[Outro — Sparse]
This is my last ride...
[Long Blues Harmonica Solo]
And it’s mine
[Acoustic Guitar fades]
